failure_reason: kohls.com is behind Akamai Bot Manager; direct fetch/WebFetch 403 immediately (consistent with prior Home-Decor pass). curl_cffi impersonation (safari260_ios profile) got past Akamai and loaded 6 of the 11 confirmed Pet Supplies category pages with live server-rendered product counts, then the 7th request (Food & Treats) returned 403 and per the access-tier 'first block stops that host' rule, no further live requests were made to kohls.com. The remaining 4 confirmed categories (Grooming, Houses & Habitats, Training & Behavior, Travel) and the Food & Treats category are recorded with verified links/existence from the sitemap taxonomy but qty=null because the live count could not be fetched.
notes: Site taxonomy discovery used the unprotected XML sitemaps (sitemap.xml -> 6x sitemap_catalog_N.xml, all HTTP 200 via curl_cffi, not Akamai-gated) rather than live nav, per the site-specific note in notes/196.md. Grepping the catalog sitemaps for 'Department:Pet Supplies' facet URLs reconstructed the full Category facet tree: Beds & Furniture, Bowls & Feeders, Clean Up, Clothes & Accessories, Collars & Leashes, Food & Treats, Grooming, Houses & Habitats, Toys, Training & Behavior, Travel (11 Category-level facets under Department:Pet Supplies; also PetType:Dog/Cat, Brand, SportsLeague/SportsTeam, Occasion, Trend, Price facets present but those are cross-cutting filters, not distinct categories, so excluded as navigation/marketing facets). No bare 'Department:Pet Supplies' landing URL (no CN param) was found in the sitemap, so the Pet Supplies department itself is emitted as a grouping row with link=null. Each Category-level PLP was then fetched live where the access budget allowed; qty was read from the page's own Astro BrowseHeading island prop blob (props="{"h1tag":[0,"<H1 text>"],"productCount":[0,<N>]}"), which is the exact number rendered next to the H1 on the page (e.g. 'Pet Toys (1,058)') -- not a raw platform/API total, matching the Storefront-count-APIs-unreliable precedent. Sub-facet 'Product' level leaves under each Category (e.g. Toys > Plush Toys / Rope & Tug Toys / Interactive Toys; Collars & Leashes > Collars / Leashes / Harnesses; Houses & Habitats > Crates & Kennels / Gates & Doors) exist per the sitemap but were NOT individually fetched -- the access block hit before they could be reached, so Category-level is used as the leaf/qty granularity in this file. All 11 categories are Tier-1 pet-care signals (feeding/bowls, beds/housing, grooming, hygiene/waste (Clean Up = litter boxes/waste bags, H1 renders as 'Pet Cleaning Supplies'), toys, walking (collars/leashes), clothing, travel/carriers, training) except Food & Treats, which is flagged per the open PET CONSUMABLE policy gap. Excluded as non-category nav/marketing/brand facets: 'Family Pajamas', 'Jammies For Your Families', 'Happy Hounds', 'Majestic Pet', 'PAW', 'PetMaker', 'Lands' End' (all Brand/Trend facets), NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/NCAA/Soccer/Los Angeles Chargers (SportsLeague/SportsTeam facets), Halloween (Occasion facet), 'Under $10' (Price facet). No PetType (Dog-only/Cat-only) rows were emitted since those are the same underlying category inventory filtered by pet type, not distinct site categories.
